# mcp-obsidian

> An MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with an Obsidian vault through the Local REST API community plugin, offering tools to list, read, search, edit, and delete notes.

Written in Python (>= 3.11) using the mcp SDK; run via uv/uvx or Docker, configured with an Obsidian REST API key in a server config or .env file. Tools include list_files_in_vault, get_file_contents, search, patch_content, append_content, and delete_file. Requires the Obsidian Local REST API plugin; debug with the MCP Inspector.

## Docs

- [mcp-obsidian README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/main/README.md): MCP server tools for interacting with Obsidian via the Local REST API plugin, with example prompts and requirements.
- [Components](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/blob/main/README.md#components): Server tools like list_files_in_vault, search, patch_content, plus example prompts for Claude.
- [Requirements](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/blob/main/README.md#requirements): Python >= 3.11 and mcp SDK version constraints, including the =2.0 import crash.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/blob/main/README.md#configuration): Setting the Obsidian REST API key via server config or a .env file, with defaults for port and host.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/blob/main/README.md#quickstart): Installing the Obsidian REST API plugin and configuring Claude Desktop on MacOS and Windows.
- [Docker](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/blob/main/README.md#docker): Running the server in Docker: .env setup, building the image, and using docker compose run with stdin attached.
- [Development](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian/blob/main/README.md#development): Building the package for distribution, debugging with the MCP Inspector, and watching server logs.
